walk.environment:
Build: the read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/tree at 9eb10528. `git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain` was empty before and after the walk, and nothing in it was edited. Every server ran from that folder with `python -c "from src.api.main import main; main()"` (the /home/user/Open-Omniscience/.venv interpreter), with the proxy variables, OO_DB_PASSPHRASE, OO_DB_PLAINTEXT, OO_EXTRACT_LEMMA and OO_NO_SCHEDULER unset and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 (launcher: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/M/boot.sh). Port 9612 throughout, one server at a time. Each server was stopped by PID only, after its /proc environ OO_DATA_DIR was checked (stop.sh; PIDs 8026, 12831, 13322 which exited by the in-app shutdown, 13658, 13906). No other walker's server was touched.

Seed: a fresh seed on THIS build, not a copied folder, so there was no old-build briefing_cache.json. I ran scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py from the worktree with the default STATE C (453 articles, 2 254 keywords), with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE=walk-pass-2026, OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset, and OO_EXTRACT_LEMMA=0 at seed time only, so the fold has work to do. That gave data1; data1-pristine is a copy taken before any boot, and data2, data3 and data4 are copies of it.
- data1: M1–M10, the boot race, and the 375 px checks.
- data2: M11 backup, fold, Pause/Resume from /tasks, and M-7.
- data3: M11 shutdown → restart → Continue, and M-7 after a restart.
- data4: M-14 during a running fold, and the 375 px consent popup.

Encryption: every open_omniscience.db has no «SQLite format 3» header. Every boot ran with neither variable set. /api/system/lock-state read {state: locked, plaintext_mode: false} before the form and unlocked-encrypted after unlocking through the real #pw / #btn-unlock form. The export reports «corpus encrypted at rest inside the backup».

Network: the boot left the app offline ({online:false}). I also POSTed /api/system/network {online:false} after every unlock. online:false was re-read after every consent popup (all closed with «Stay offline», 12 idle and 6 during a running fold on top of the M9 opens), after the external-link confirm (dismissed), after Refresh, and after the /tasks Resume. «Go online» was never pressed, in the popup or in the coach. Zero off-host requests in any run.

Browser: Playwright Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, headless, args --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --no-proxy-server, proxy variables unset.

Passes: en, fr, ar (rtl) and zh at 1440x950; ja for the ring panel; en and fr at 375x800. Boot-race probes delayed /static/locales/fr.json by 2.5 s and 3.0 s through a Playwright route (the route hits are logged in g.json).

Scripts, JSON and screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/M/ (a–j .py/.json/_log.json, shots/).

walk.summary:
